discussion_comments.comment_body:
Addressed in d3bf855c. Implemented your "distinguish untouched generator output from user-modified" suggestion via a new `looksLikeGeneratorOutput()` heuristic: existing pointer files whose body still ends with `@skills/<canonicalId>` and whose frontmatter has only a single `description:` line are treated as generator output and refreshed in place when the manifest description changes (counted as `updated`). Hand-modified pointer files (body diverges from the pattern) remain preserved unless `forceCommands: true`.

Regression test in Suite 8: "Generator-shaped pointer is refreshed when manifest description changes" — rewrites the manifest with a new description, re-runs install, asserts the on-disk pointer reflects the new description. Hand-edit preservation is also tested in a follow-up commit (ccc0d4f7) with a sentinel that survives a routine reinstall via `previousSkillIds`.
Fixed — changed to `includes(folder + "/")` for boundary-safe matching. Also handles the raw `output_folder` case (no `{project-root}/` prefix) from the `--yes` path.

Good catch on the theoretical edge case. In practice, the installer always derives artifact paths from `{output_folder}`, so the substring match will always be the actual output folder — not an unrelated mid-path segment. `startsWith` would miss the `--yes` case where `output_folder` is the bare `_bmad-output` but artifact paths have `{project-root}/_bmad-output/...`. Keeping `includes` with the `/` boundary is the pragmatic choice here.
Addressed — replaced the literal string match with a regex `/\]\((?:\.\/)?workflow\.md\)/g` that only targets Markdown link destinations. This also covers the `./workflow.md` variant.
Fixed in a5aa8f84 — added `rootDir` parameter to `findWorkflowFiles`, `scanDirectory`, and `scanDirectoryWithStandalone` so `relativePath` is always anchored to the original scan root.
**Fixed** in 7c2bb149 — Replaced positional `line.split(',')` parser with `csv-parse/sync` header-based parsing. Also fixed pre-existing off-by-one where `cols[10]` read path instead of module.

The guard now uses a filename-aware regex (`forbiddenRefPattern`) instead of raw substring matching, so `validate-workflow.xml` no longer false- positives as `workflow.xml`. I also kept the offenders list behavior unchanged and expanded scan coverage to installer JS files.
